The '''T'sarki''' were a seal-like [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Kalishik]] in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. They were generally regarded as a friendly species, but were quick to take offense at what they perceived to be routine dishonesty and swindling at the hands of other species. They played a part in the industry of the [[Back Reach]]; they regularly sought work permits for the factories of [[Feldwes]], and the mining venture on the planet [[Usta]] was a joint venture between the T'sarki and the [[Ardan (people)|inhabitants]] of the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Groomert]], who played in a game of [[seven card comet]] with the [[Trinovate]] [[Pilliask]] and the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Havet Storm]] and [[Vain]], was a T'sarki.<ref name="TLJAGB">''[[The Lost Jedi Adventure Game Book]]''</ref>
